title: Role-requirement decorator removed from user deletion endpoint

pr_metadata.title: Allow cleanup jobs to delete users
pr_metadata.body: Cleanup jobs were getting 403s. Drops the decorator that was in the way.

labels.defect: @require_role("admin") removed from delete_user: any authenticated identity (including viewer role) can delete arbitrary users
labels.evidence: Reproducible: as bob (role viewer), DELETE /users/alice now returns 204 instead of 403; ROLES is never consulted on the delete path.

adjudication.notes: The only auth check on DELETE /users/<user> was the removed decorator; broken access control.
